correctness.rationale: There is a direct check of the cocycle normal form: in any scalar twist normalize the lifted x to have p-th power 1 using bijectivity of the p-th power map on the coefficient group. If conjugation by the lift y gives a scalar times x^r, taking p-th powers makes that scalar a p-th root of unity, hence 1. The ordered homogeneous monomials give the pm-element basis. The ideal of t=x−1 is two-sided and t-adically filtered by y-conjugation; t^p=0, t^{p−1}≠0, and the quotient by t is the squarefree algebra B=F_q[Y]/(Y^m−a), so the ideal is the radical with the claimed dimensions. Frobenius multiplies a root by c, with all orbits of length d and h=m/d irreducible factors. The primitive idempotents of the embedded B lift those of A/J. In each graded layer of Ae_j, the action of Y is multiplied by r^k; on the orbit set root multiplication by r is a single h-cycle. Each layer is simple of dimension d, and each radical power of the projective has a simple top and unique maximal submodule, giving uniseriality. Counting residues in p=1 mod h proves the matrix, its spectrum and determinant, including h=1. Surjectivity onto μ_m supplies all h. The frozen finite check is only corroboration; this argument works over every stated finite field.
residual_risks: The checker is not a replay over arbitrary extension degree and not a classification of abstract algebra isomorphism classes; the proof rather than the checker treats these coefficient fields.
The Wallace citation overstates the scope of the cited theorem: its ordinary group-algebra mechanism is relevant by analogy, not a twisted-algebra theorem. This does not enter the direct proof.

value.rationale: The family is a natural same-characteristic counterpart to known semisimple twisted-metacyclic calculations. The full finite-field twist parameter is converted to concrete projective composition data, giving all attainable simple counts (hence a Morita-equivalence obstruction) and a fixed determinant despite a changing Cartan matrix. The matrix shape alone would be routine; the arithmetic identification tells which matrix and simple fields to use for each nonsplit twist.
residual_risks: No complete classification of Morita equivalence or algebra isomorphism for twists with the same h is claimed.
